class WebRCON:
    """Small bounded RFC6455 client for Rust's native JSON RCON protocol."""
    def __init__(self, port, password):
        self.socket = socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', port), timeout=3)
        self.buffer = b''
        key = base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(16)).decode()
        request = 'GET /'+quote(password, safe='')+' HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:'+str(port)+'\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Key: '+key+'\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\n\r\n'
        self.socket.sendall(request.encode())
        while b'\r\n\r\n' not in self.buffer:
            block = self.socket.recv(4096)
            if not block:raise OSError('Rust WebRCON closed during handshake')
            self.buffer += block
            if len(self.buffer) > 16384:raise ValueError('Oversized WebRCON handshake')
        header, self.buffer = self.buffer.split(b'\r\n\r\n', 1)
        expected = base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha1((key+'258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11').encode()).digest())
        headers = {}
        for line in header.split(b'\r\n')[1:]:
            if b':' in line:
                name, item = line.split(b':', 1);headers[name.lower()] = item.strip()
        if not header.split(b'\r\n')[0].startswith(b'HTTP/1.1 101 ') or headers.get(b'sec-websocket-accept') != expected:
            self.close();raise OSError('Rust WebRCON authentication or upgrade failed')
        self.sequence = 0

    def close(self):self.socket.close()

    def frame(self, payload, opcode=1):
        if len(payload) > 1048576:raise ValueError('WebRCON message exceeds limit')
        mask = secrets.token_bytes(4)
        length = len(payload)
        prefix = bytes([0x80 | opcode, 0x80 | length]) if length < 126 else bytes([0x80 | opcode, 0xfe])+struct.pack('!H', length) if length <= 65535 else bytes([0x80 | opcode, 0xff])+struct.pack('!Q', length)
        self.socket.sendall(prefix+mask+bytes(byte ^ mask[i%4] for i, byte in enumerate(payload)))

    def send(self, command):
        self.sequence += 1
        self.frame(json.dumps({'Identifier':self.sequence, 'Message':command, 'Name':'Voltra'}).encode())

    def take(self, count):
        while len(self.buffer) < count:
            block = self.socket.recv(max(4096, count-len(self.buffer)))
            if not block:raise OSError('Rust WebRCON disconnected')
            self.buffer += block
        result, self.buffer = self.buffer[:count], self.buffer[count:]
        return result

    def receive(self):
        # Keep the complete frame buffered until available. A socket timeout in
        # a fragmented frame must not discard its already-read header.
        def ensure(count):
            while len(self.buffer) < count:
                block = self.socket.recv(max(4096, count-len(self.buffer)))
                if not block:raise OSError('Rust WebRCON disconnected')
                self.buffer += block
        ensure(2)
        first, second = self.buffer[:2]
        length = second & 127
        offset = 2
        if length == 126:
            ensure(4);length = struct.unpack('!H', self.buffer[2:4])[0];offset = 4
        elif length == 127:
            ensure(10);length = struct.unpack('!Q', self.buffer[2:10])[0];offset = 10
        if length > 1048576:raise ValueError('WebRCON response exceeds limit')
        if second & 128:raise ValueError('Server WebSocket frame must not be masked')
        ensure(offset+length)
        payload, self.buffer = self.buffer[offset:offset+length], self.buffer[offset+length:]
        opcode = first & 15
        if opcode == 8:raise OSError('Rust WebRCON closed')
        if opcode == 9:self.frame(payload, 10);return None
        if opcode != 1 or not first & 128:raise ValueError('Unsupported Rust WebRCON frame')
        return json.loads(payload)


def run(root, argv, environment, port, password, credentials=()):
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=root, env=environment, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    finished, ready, stopping, transport_ready = threading.Event(), threading.Event(), threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    commands = queue.Queue(maxsize=256)
    lock = threading.Lock()
    announcement_lock = threading.Lock()
    announced = False
    def emit(data):
        with lock:
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(data);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
    def announce():
        nonlocal announced
        with announcement_lock:
            if ready.is_set() and transport_ready.is_set() and not announced:
                announced = True;emit(b'VOLTRA_RUST_READY\n')
    def output():
        redactor = Redactor([password, *credentials])
        for line in iter(child.stdout.readline, b''):
            if b'Server startup complete' in line:ready.set();announce()
            emit(redactor.feed(line, final=line.endswith(b'\n')))
        emit(redactor.feed(b'', final=True))
    def input_commands():
        pending = b''
        try:
            for block in iter(lambda:os.read(sys.stdin.fileno(), 65536), b''):
                pending += block
                if len(pending) > 1048576:raise ValueError('Rust console input exceeds limit')
                while b'\n' in pending:
                    line, pending = pending.split(b'\n', 1)
                    command = line.decode('utf-8').rstrip('\r')
                    if command.strip().casefold() == 'quit':stopping.set()
                    elif command.strip():commands.put(command, timeout=3)
        except (OSError, ValueError, queue.Full):emit(b'Rust console input rejected or closed.\n')
    def rcon_loop():
        stop_sent = False
        while not finished.is_set():
            connection = None
            try:
                connection = WebRCON(port, password)
                transport_ready.set();announce()
                emit(b'VOLTRA_RUST_RCON_READY\n')
                # Native stdout is authoritative; RCON replies supply command results.
                redactor = Redactor([password, *credentials])
                while not finished.is_set():
                    if stopping.is_set() and not stop_sent:
                        connection.send('quit');stop_sent = True
                    try:command = commands.get_nowait()
                    except queue.Empty:command = None
                    if command:connection.send(command)
                    connection.socket.settimeout(0.2)
                    try:message = connection.receive()
                    except socket.timeout:continue
                    if isinstance(message, dict) and message.get('Identifier', 0) > 0:
                        emit(redactor.feed((str(message.get('Message', ''))+'\n').encode(), final=True))
            except (OSError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                if not finished.wait(1):continue
            finally:
                if connection:connection.close()
    native_stopping = threading.Event()
    def stop(*_):
        # Rust's RCON quit path terminates differently from Unity's native
        # shutdown signal. Let the publisher finish its save and teardown hooks.
        if child.poll() is None and not native_stopping.is_set():
            native_stopping.set();child.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop);signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    threads = [threading.Thread(target=target, daemon=True) for target in (output, input_commands, rcon_loop)]
    for thread in threads:thread.start()
    try:
        code = child.wait()
        threads[0].join(timeout=2)
        return code if announced else (code or 1)
    finally:
        finished.set();threads[0].join(timeout=2);child.stdout.close()


def main():
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    if environment.get('VOLTRA_STEAM_AUTO_UPDATE', environment.get('AUTO_UPDATE', '0')) == '1':
        from rust_install import install
        install(root, environment, wipe=False)
    argv, child_env, port, password = configure(root, environment)
    return run(root, argv, child_env, port, password, [environment.get(name, '') for name in ('STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH', 'SRCDS_BETAPASS')])


if __name__ == '__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

def confined(root, relative):
    path = PurePosixPath(relative)
    if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in relative or not path.parts:
        raise ValueError('Rust operation must stay inside this server volume')
    target = root.joinpath(*path.parts)
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError('Rust path follows a link outside this server volume')
    return target


WIPE_PROTECTED = frozenset(('.voltra', '.steam', 'steamapps'))


def mount_points():
    # Device numbers alone miss bind mounts of the same filesystem.
    table = Path('/proc/self/mountinfo')
    if not table.is_file():raise ValueError('Rust wipe requires Linux mount information')
    return {Path(re.sub(r'\\([0-7]{3})', lambda match:chr(int(match[1],8)), line.split()[4]))
            for line in table.read_text().splitlines() if len(line.split()) >= 5}


def volume_directory_fd(root,path,mounts):
    descriptor = os.open(root,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    current = root;device = os.fstat(descriptor).st_dev
    try:
        for part in path.relative_to(root).parts:
            current /= part
            if current in mounts:raise ValueError('Wipe cannot cross a mounted filesystem')
            info = os.stat(part,dir_fd=descriptor,follow_symlinks=False)
            if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):raise ValueError('Wipe path contains a symbolic link or non-directory parent')
            if current in mounts or info.st_dev != device:raise ValueError('Wipe cannot cross a mounted filesystem')
            following = os.open(part,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,dir_fd=descriptor)
            observed = os.fstat(following)
            if (observed.st_dev,observed.st_ino) != (info.st_dev,info.st_ino):
                os.close(following);raise ValueError('Wipe directory changed during validation')
            os.close(descriptor);descriptor = following
        return descriptor
    except BaseException:
        os.close(descriptor);raise

    descriptor = volume_directory_fd(root,path,mounts)
    try:
        with os.scandir(descriptor) as entries:return [path/entry.name for entry in entries]
    finally:os.close(descriptor)


def wipe_path(root, path, mounts):
    relative = path.relative_to(root)
    if not relative.parts or relative.parts[0] in WIPE_PROTECTED:
        raise ValueError('Wipe cannot target the server root, updater state or quarantine')
    if path in mounts:raise ValueError('Wipe cannot cross a mounted filesystem: '+str(relative))
    descriptor = volume_directory_fd(root,path.parent,mounts)
    try:info = os.stat(path.name,dir_fd=descriptor,follow_symlinks=False)
    finally:os.close(descriptor)
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):raise ValueError('Wipe rejects symbolic links instead of following them: '+str(relative))
    if path in mounts or info.st_dev != root.stat().st_dev:
        raise ValueError('Wipe cannot cross a mounted filesystem: '+str(relative))
    if not (stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)):
        raise ValueError('Wipe supports ordinary files and directories, not devices or sockets')

            elif index+1 < len(parts):yield from expand(base,index+1)
            for path in wipe_children(root,base,mounts):

                if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):yield from expand(path,index)
                elif index == len(parts)-1:yield path

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata


def _publication_check(root):
    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)


def _publish(root, relative, writer, default_mode=0o644):
    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)
        temporary, descriptor, identity = None, None, None
        try:
            for attempt in range(5):
                candidate = '.voltra-publish-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
                try:
                    descriptor = os.open(candidate, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                         0o600, dir_fd=parent)

                except FileExistsError:
                    continue
            if descriptor is None:
                raise ValueError('Cannot reserve a private Steam publication file')
            identity = os.fstat(descriptor)

                writer(output)
                output.flush()
            metadata = previous or volume
            if os.geteuid() == 0:
                os.fchown(descriptor, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
            os.fchmod(descriptor, stat.S_IMODE(previous.st_mode) if previous else default_mode)
            os.fsync(descriptor)

                if current is None or (os.fstat(current).st_dev, os.fstat(current).st_ino) != (os.fstat(parent).st_dev, os.fstat(parent).st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication parent changed')
                latest = _publication_leaf(current, leaf)
                signature = lambda value: None if value is None else (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)
                if signature(latest) != signature(previous):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication destination changed')
                candidate = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                if (candidate.st_dev, candidate.st_ino) != (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication temporary file changed')

                temporary = None

        finally:
            if temporary is not None and identity is not None:
                # Remove only the inode reserved by this invocation. A replaced
                # or unknown name is never deleted as failure cleanup.
                try:
                    current = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                    if (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):

class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'

        return

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:

            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):

                if path.as_posix() == '.':

class WebRCON:

    def send(self, command):
        self.sequence += 1

    def take(self, count):
        while len(self.buffer) < count:

            if not block:raise OSError('Rust WebRCON disconnected')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Shared SteamCMD contract for imported game templates, without shell flags."""
import hashlib
from contextlib import contextmanager
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata


def _publication_check(root):
    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)


def _publish(root, relative, writer, default_mode=0o644):
    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)
        temporary, descriptor, identity = None, None, None
        try:
            for attempt in range(5):
                candidate = '.voltra-publish-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
                try:
                    descriptor = os.open(candidate, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                         0o600, dir_fd=parent)
                    temporary = candidate
                    break
                except FileExistsError:
                    continue
            if descriptor is None:
                raise ValueError('Cannot reserve a private Steam publication file')
            identity = os.fstat(descriptor)
            with os.fdopen(os.dup(descriptor), 'wb') as output:
                writer(output)
                output.flush()
            metadata = previous or volume
            if os.geteuid() == 0:
                os.fchown(descriptor, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
            os.fchmod(descriptor, stat.S_IMODE(previous.st_mode) if previous else default_mode)
            os.fsync(descriptor)
            with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (current, leaf, _):
                if current is None or (os.fstat(current).st_dev, os.fstat(current).st_ino) != (os.fstat(parent).st_dev, os.fstat(parent).st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication parent changed')
                latest = _publication_leaf(current, leaf)
                signature = lambda value: None if value is None else (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)
                if signature(latest) != signature(previous):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication destination changed')
                candidate = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                if (candidate.st_dev, candidate.st_ino) != (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication temporary file changed')
                os.replace(temporary, name, src_dir_fd=parent, dst_dir_fd=parent)
                temporary = None
                os.fsync(parent)
            _publication_check(root)
        finally:
            if temporary is not None and identity is not None:
                # Remove only the inode reserved by this invocation. A replaced
                # or unknown name is never deleted as failure cleanup.
                try:
                    current = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                    if (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):

class SteamInstallError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, app_id, status, reason):
        self.app_id, self.status, self.reason = app_id, status, reason
        super().__init__('SteamCMD failed (' + reason + '); inspect the redacted installation output')


def failure_reason(output, app_id):
    clean = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', output)
    expected = ("ERROR! Failed to install app '" + str(app_id) + "' (Invalid platform)").encode('ascii')
    return 'invalid_platform' if any(line.strip() == expected for line in clean.splitlines()) else 'steamcmd_failed'


def arguments(root, app_id, env, validate=True, platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    # SteamCMD reparses its argv using its own command language. Raw argv is
    # therefore not a faithful credential transport (e.g. a leading + value
    # becomes another command). Keep unverified private paths unavailable.
    if (env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '') or env.get('STEAM_PASS', '') or
            env.get('STEAM_AUTH', '') or env.get('STEAM_USER', '') not in ('', 'anonymous')):
        raise ValueError('Private Steam credentials are not enabled until native command parsing is verified')
    if not isinstance(app_id, int) or isinstance(app_id, bool) or not 1 <= app_id <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError('Choose a numeric Steam application ID')
    branch = env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '')
    if branch and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}', branch):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam branch name')
    credentials = [env.get(name, '') for name in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH')]
    if any(value.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value) for value in credentials):
        raise ValueError('Steam credentials cannot contain controls or begin with command prefixes')
    if credentials[0] and credentials[0] != 'anonymous':
        if not credentials[1]:
            raise ValueError('A Steam account password is required for account login')
        login = credentials[:2] + ([credentials[2]] if credentials[2] else [])
    else:
        login = ['anonymous']
    if platform not in ('linux', 'windows'):
        raise ValueError('Choose a reviewed Steam target platform')
    if not isinstance(force_platform, bool): raise ValueError('Platform selection must be an explicit boolean')
    if env.get('WINDOWS_INSTALL', '1' if platform == 'windows' else '0') != ('1' if platform == 'windows' else '0'):
        raise ValueError('Steam target platform does not match this reviewed template')
    args = [str(root / '.voltra/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh'), '+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand', '1',
            '+@NoPromptForPassword', '1', '+force_install_dir', str(root)]
    if platform == 'windows' or force_platform:
        args += ['+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType', platform]
    args += ['+login', *login,
            # Required for first installs in a cold SteamCMD metadata cache.
            '+app_info_update', '1', '+app_info_print', str(app_id)]
    if app_id == 90:
        game = env.get('HLDS_GAME', 'cstrike')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}', game):
            raise ValueError('Choose a native HLDS mod directory')
        args += ['+app_set_config', '90', 'mod', game]
    args += ['+app_update', str(app_id)]
    if branch and branch != 'public':
        args += ['-beta', branch]
    beta_password = env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '')
    if beta_password:
        if not branch or branch == 'public' or beta_password.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in beta_password):
            raise ValueError('A beta password requires a selected private branch')
        args += ['-betapassword', beta_password]
    if env.get('INSTALL_FLAGS', ''):
        raise ValueError('Use typed Steam options instead of arbitrary INSTALL_FLAGS')
    if validate:
        args += ['validate']

def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')
    if (target / 'steamcmd.sh').is_file() and (target / 'linux32/steamcmd').is_file():
        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'steamcmd.tar.gz'
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BOOTSTRAP, timeout=120) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap redirected outside HTTPS')
            while True:
                block = response.read(1048576)
                if not block:
                    break
                count += len(block)
                if count > 128 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap archive exceeds its size limit')
                checksum.update(block)
                output.write(block)

@contextmanager

    return 'invalid_platform' if any(line.strip() == expected for line in clean.splitlines()) else 'steamcmd_failed'


def arguments(root, app_id, env, validate=True, platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    # SteamCMD reparses its argv using its own command language. Raw argv is
    # therefore not a faithful credential transport (e.g. a leading + value
    # becomes another command). Keep unverified private paths unavailable.
    if (env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '') or env.get('STEAM_PASS', '') or
            env.get('STEAM_AUTH', '') or env.get('STEAM_USER', '') not in ('', 'anonymous')):
        raise ValueError('Private Steam credentials are not enabled until native command parsing is verified')
    if not isinstance(app_id, int) or isinstance(app_id, bool) or not 1 <= app_id <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError('Choose a numeric Steam application ID')

        raise ValueError('Steam credentials cannot contain controls or begin with command prefixes')

        raise ValueError('Choose a reviewed Steam target platform')
    if not isinstance(force_platform, bool): raise ValueError('Platform selection must be an explicit boolean')
    if env.get('WINDOWS_INSTALL', '1' if platform == 'windows' else '0') != ('1' if platform == 'windows' else '0'):
        raise ValueError('Steam target platform does not match this reviewed template')
    args = [str(root / '.voltra/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh'), '+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand', '1',
            '+@NoPromptForPassword', '1', '+force_install_dir', str(root)]
    if platform == 'windows' or force_platform:
        args += ['+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType', platform]
    args += ['+login', *login,

            '+app_info_update', '1', '+app_info_print', str(app_id)]

        game = env.get('HLDS_GAME', 'cstrike')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}', game):
            raise ValueError('Choose a native HLDS mod directory')
        args += ['+app_set_config', '90', 'mod', game]
    args += ['+app_update', str(app_id)]
    if branch and branch != 'public':
        args += ['-beta', branch]
    beta_password = env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '')
    if beta_password:
        if not branch or branch == 'public' or beta_password.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in beta_password):

def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')
    if (target / 'steamcmd.sh').is_file() and (target / 'linux32/steamcmd').is_file():
        return

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'steamcmd.tar.gz'
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BOOTSTRAP, timeout=120) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap redirected outside HTTPS')
            while True:
                block = response.read(1048576)
                if not block:

                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap archive exceeds its size limit')
                checksum.update(block)

        ready = stage / 'ready'; ready.mkdir()
        seen, total = set(), 0
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as source:
            for member in source:
                path = PurePosixPath(member.name)
                if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.name or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                    raise ValueError('Unsafe SteamCMD bootstrap archive')
                if path.as_posix() == '.':
                    continue

                    raise ValueError('Duplicate SteamCMD bootstrap path')
                seen.add(path.as_posix()); total += member.size
                if len(seen) > 10000 or total > 512 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap expansion exceeds its limit')
                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)
                if member.isdir():
                    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            if not (ready / name).is_file():
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap is missing its launcher')

        if target.exists():
            raise ValueError('Incomplete existing SteamCMD folder needs operator review')
        os.replace(ready, target)
        (target.parent / 'steamcmd-bootstrap.json').write_text(json.dumps({'url': BOOTSTRAP, 'sha256': checksum.hexdigest(), 'bytes': count}) + '\n')


def update(root, app_id, env=None, validate=True, required=(), platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    supplied_root = root.absolute()
    root = root.resolve()
    env = os.environ if env is None else env
    args = arguments(root, app_id, env, validate, platform=platform, force_platform=force_platform)
    if supplied_root != root:
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume must not contain symlinks or traversal')
    _publication_check(root)
    bootstrap(root)
    _publication_check(root)
    child_env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': str(root)}
    for name in ('PYTHONHOME', 'PYTHONPATH', 'LD_PRELOAD'):
        child_env.pop(name, None)
    # The bundled Python dependency directory belongs to the helper only.
    child_env.pop('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', None)
    print('SteamCMD: refresh target metadata, then ' + ('validate/install' if validate else 'update') + ' application ' + str(app_id), flush=True)
    child = subprocess.Popen(['timeout', '--signal=TERM', '--kill-after=30s', '7200s', *args], cwd=root, env=child_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)

    except BaseException:
        child.terminate()

        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()

        # contain Steam credentials. Never let that exception reach the console.
        raise RuntimeError('Steam helper interrupted; inspect the redacted output') from None
    if status != 0:
        raise SteamInstallError(app_id, status, failure_reason(failure_tail, app_id))
    _publication_check(root)
    receipt = manifest(root, app_id)
    for name in required:
        path = root / name
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:

            if parent is None or _publication_leaf(parent, name) is None:

            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as source:
                metadata = os.fstat(source.fileno())

    payload = (json.dumps({**receipt, 'branch': env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '') or 'public', 'platform': platform}, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    _publish(root, '.voltra/steam-template-release.json', lambda output: output.write(payload))
    return receipt

                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__', 'site-packages', 'dist-packages', 'test', 'tests'))
        binaries = [stage / 'bin/python3', *library.rglob('*.so')]
        dependencies = set()
        for binary in binaries:
            result = subprocess.run(['ldd', str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            if result.returncode:
                raise ValueError('Cannot inspect bundled Python dependencies')
            if 'not found' in result.stdout:
                raise ValueError('Installer is missing a Python shared library')
            dependencies.update(re.findall(r'=>\s+(/[^\s]+)', result.stdout))

        glibc = ('libc.so.', 'libm.so.', 'libdl.so.', 'libpthread.so.', 'librt.so.', 'libresolv.so.', 'libutil.so.')
        for name in sorted(dependencies):
            source = Path(name)
            if not source.name.startswith(glibc):
                shutil.copy2(source, library / source.name)
        notices = stage / 'licenses'; notices.mkdir()
        for source in Path('/usr/share/doc').glob('*/copyright'):
            shutil.copy2(source, notices / (source.parent.name.replace(':', '_') + '.copyright'))
        (stage / 'packages.txt').write_text(packages)
        (stage / 'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity) + '\n')
        backup = root / '.voltra' / ('python-previous-' + str(time.time_ns()))
        if target.exists():
            os.replace(target, backup)
        try:
            os.replace(stage, target)
        except BaseException:
            if backup.exists():
                os.replace(backup, target)
            raise
        # Unchanged reinstalls reuse a checked bundle. Changed packages retain
        # the previous interpreter for recovery, without touching operator data.
    print('Debian Python runtime and package notices installed.', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    bundle(Path.cwd())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import time


def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'
    result, seen_sections, seen_keys = [], set(), set()
    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline
        if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)
            missing(name)
    return ''.join(result)


def private_write(path, content):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):
        raise ValueError('Native configuration leaves the server volume')
    if path.exists():
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as source:previous = source.read()
    else:previous = ''
    updated = patch_ini(previous, sections)
    if updated != previous:
        if path.exists():private_write(backups / (str(time.time_ns()) + '-' + path.parent.name + '-' + path.name), previous)
        private_write(path, updated)
    else:path.chmod(0o600)

"""MIT. Shared SteamCMD contract for imported game templates, without shell flags."""
import hashlib

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata

    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)

    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):

class SteamInstallError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, app_id, status, reason):
        self.app_id, self.status, self.reason = app_id, status, reason
        super().__init__('SteamCMD failed (' + reason + '); inspect the redacted installation output')


def failure_reason(output, app_id):
    clean = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', output)
    expected = ("ERROR! Failed to install app '" + str(app_id) + "' (Invalid platform)").encode('ascii')
    return 'invalid_platform' if any(line.strip() == expected for line in clean.splitlines()) else 'steamcmd_failed'


def arguments(root, app_id, env, validate=True, platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    # SteamCMD reparses its argv using its own command language. Raw argv is
    # therefore not a faithful credential transport (e.g. a leading + value
    # becomes another command). Keep unverified private paths unavailable.
    if (env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '') or env.get('STEAM_PASS', '') or
            env.get('STEAM_AUTH', '') or env.get('STEAM_USER', '') not in ('', 'anonymous')):
        raise ValueError('Private Steam credentials are not enabled until native command parsing is verified')
    if not isinstance(app_id, int) or isinstance(app_id, bool) or not 1 <= app_id <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError('Choose a numeric Steam application ID')
    branch = env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '')
    if branch and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}', branch):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam branch name')
    credentials = [env.get(name, '') for name in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH')]
    if any(value.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value) for value in credentials):
        raise ValueError('Steam credentials cannot contain controls or begin with command prefixes')
    if credentials[0] and credentials[0] != 'anonymous':
        if not credentials[1]:
            raise ValueError('A Steam account password is required for account login')
        login = credentials[:2] + ([credentials[2]] if credentials[2] else [])
    else:
        login = ['anonymous']
    if platform not in ('linux', 'windows'):
        raise ValueError('Choose a reviewed Steam target platform')
    if not isinstance(force_platform, bool): raise ValueError('Platform selection must be an explicit boolean')
    if env.get('WINDOWS_INSTALL', '1' if platform == 'windows' else '0') != ('1' if platform == 'windows' else '0'):
        raise ValueError('Steam target platform does not match this reviewed template')
    args = [str(root / '.voltra/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh'), '+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand', '1',
            '+@NoPromptForPassword', '1', '+force_install_dir', str(root)]
    if platform == 'windows' or force_platform:
        args += ['+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType', platform]
    args += ['+login', *login,
            # Required for first installs in a cold SteamCMD metadata cache.
            '+app_info_update', '1', '+app_info_print', str(app_id)]
    if app_id == 90:
        game = env.get('HLDS_GAME', 'cstrike')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}', game):
            raise ValueError('Choose a native HLDS mod directory')
        args += ['+app_set_config', '90', 'mod', game]
    args += ['+app_update', str(app_id)]
    if branch and branch != 'public':
        args += ['-beta', branch]
    beta_password = env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '')
    if beta_password:
        if not branch or branch == 'public' or beta_password.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in beta_password):
            raise ValueError('A beta password requires a selected private branch')
        args += ['-betapassword', beta_password]
    if env.get('INSTALL_FLAGS', ''):
        raise ValueError('Use typed Steam options instead of arbitrary INSTALL_FLAGS')
    if validate:
        args += ['validate']
    return args + ['+quit']


def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')
    if (target / 'steamcmd.sh').is_file() and (target / 'linux32/steamcmd').is_file():
        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'steamcmd.tar.gz'
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BOOTSTRAP, timeout=120) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap redirected outside HTTPS')
            while True:
                block = response.read(1048576)
                if not block:
                    break
                count += len(block)
                if count > 128 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap archive exceeds its size limit')
                checksum.update(block)
                output.write(block)
        ready = stage / 'ready'; ready.mkdir()
        seen, total = set(), 0
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as source:
            for member in source:
                path = PurePosixPath(member.name)
                if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.name or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                    raise ValueError('Unsafe SteamCMD bootstrap archive')
                if path.as_posix() == '.':
                    continue
                if path.as_posix() in seen:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate SteamCMD bootstrap path')
                seen.add(path.as_posix()); total += member.size
                if len(seen) > 10000 or total > 512 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap expansion exceeds its limit')
                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)
                if member.isdir():
                    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    with source.extractfile(member) as inp, destination.open('xb') as output:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(inp, output)
                    destination.chmod(member.mode & 0o777)
        for name in ('steamcmd.sh', 'linux32/steamcmd'):
            if not (ready / name).is_file():
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap is missing its launcher')
            (ready / name).chmod(0o755)
        if target.exists():
            raise ValueError('Incomplete existing SteamCMD folder needs operator review')
        os.replace(ready, target)
        (target.parent / 'steamcmd-bootstrap.json').write_text(json.dumps({'url': BOOTSTRAP, 'sha256': checksum.hexdigest(), 'bytes': count}) + '\n')


def update(root, app_id, env=None, validate=True, required=(), platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    supplied_root = root.absolute()
    root = root.resolve()
    env = os.environ if env is None else env
    args = arguments(root, app_id, env, validate, platform=platform, force_platform=force_platform)
    if supplied_root != root:
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume must not contain symlinks or traversal')
    _publication_check(root)
    bootstrap(root)
    _publication_check(root)
    child_env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': str(root)}
    for name in ('PYTHONHOME', 'PYTHONPATH', 'LD_PRELOAD'):
        child_env.pop(name, None)
    # The bundled Python dependency directory belongs to the helper only.
    child_env.pop('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', None)
    print('SteamCMD: refresh target metadata, then ' + ('validate/install' if validate else 'update') + ' application ' + str(app_id), flush=True)
    child = subprocess.Popen(['timeout', '--signal=TERM', '--kill-after=30s', '7200s', *args], cwd=root, env=child_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    secrets = [env.get(key, '') for key in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH', 'SRCDS_BETAPASS')]
    redactor = Redactor(secrets)
    failure_tail = b''
    import sys
    try:
        while True:
            block = child.stdout.read1(16384)
            if not block:
                break
            failure_tail = (failure_tail + block)[-8192:]
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(redactor.feed(block)); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(redactor.feed(b'', final=True)); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        status = child.wait()
    except BaseException:
        child.terminate()
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()
            child.wait()
        # TimeoutExpired includes the original command arguments, which can
        # contain Steam credentials. Never let that exception reach the console.
        raise RuntimeError('Steam helper interrupted; inspect the redacted output') from None
    if status != 0:
        raise SteamInstallError(app_id, status, failure_reason(failure_tail, app_id))
    _publication_check(root)
    receipt = manifest(root, app_id)
    for name in required:
        path = root / name
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            raise ValueError('Steam installation lacks a required server file')
    for bits in ('32', '64'):
        with _publication_parent(root, '.voltra/steamcmd/linux' + bits + '/steamclient.so') as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is None or _publication_leaf(parent, name) is None:
                continue
            descriptor = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as source:
                metadata = os.fstat(source.fileno())
                if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
                    raise ValueError('Steam SDK source must be a regular file')
                _publish(root, '.steam/sdk' + bits + '/steamclient.so',
                         lambda output: shutil.copyfileobj(source, output), metadata.st_mode & 0o777)
    payload = (json.dumps({**receipt, 'branch': env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '') or 'public', 'platform': platform}, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    _publish(root, '.voltra/steam-template-release.json', lambda output: output.write(payload))
    return receipt

        binaries = [stage / 'bin/python3', *library.rglob('*.so')]

        for name in sorted(dependencies):
            source = Path(name)
            if not source.name.startswith(glibc):
                shutil.copy2(source, library / source.name)
        notices = stage / 'licenses'; notices.mkdir()
        for source in Path('/usr/share/doc').glob('*/copyright'):

        (stage / 'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity) + '\n')
        backup = root / '.voltra' / ('python-previous-' + str(time.time_ns()))
        if target.exists():
            os.replace(target, backup)
        try:
            os.replace(stage, target)
        except BaseException:
            if backup.exists():
                os.replace(backup, target)
            raise
        # Unchanged reinstalls reuse a checked bundle. Changed packages retain
        # the previous interpreter for recovery, without touching operator data.
    print('Debian Python runtime and package notices installed.', flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import time


def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'
    result, seen_sections, seen_keys = [], set(), set()
    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline
        if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)
            missing(name)
    return ''.join(result)


def private_write(path, content):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):
        raise ValueError('Native configuration leaves the server volume')
    if path.exists():
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as source:previous = source.read()
    else:previous = ''
    updated = patch_ini(previous, sections)
    if updated != previous:
        if path.exists():private_write(backups / (str(time.time_ns()) + '-' + path.parent.name + '-' + path.name), previous)
        private_write(path, updated)
    else:path.chmod(0o600)

def terminal_queries(data, pending=b'', final=False):
    """Minimal opt-in DSR replies, not a VT screen emulator. Position is 1;1."""
    data=pending+data;output=bytearray();replies=[];index=0
    queries={b'\x1b[6n':b'\x1b[1;1R',b'\x1b[5n':b'\x1b[0n'}
    while index<len(data):
        matched=next((q for q in queries if data.startswith(q,index)),None)
        if matched:
            replies.append(queries[matched]);index+=len(matched);continue
        if not final and any(q.startswith(data[index:]) for q in queries):return bytes(output),data[index:],replies
        output.append(data[index]);index+=1

    output=bytearray()
