variables.name: ReHLDS Version
variables.description: Reviewed immutable community module bundle. latest selects commit 87b606ded4cdf754284dacb9bd3664e08b100519; upstream previously ignored this variable.

variables.name: Available Modules
variables.description: Comma separated native modules. Reunion needs ReHLDS and Metamod; AMXX needs Metamod; ReAPI needs ReHLDS and AMXX. Empty installs publisher CS1.6 only.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Native server browser name.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Installed native BSP map name without the extension. Half-Life uses maps such as crossfire; Counter-Strike uses de_dust2.

variables.name: Automatic updates
variables.description: Use the shared typed updater on startup; the panel disables the runtime image legacy updater.

variables.name: Game ID
variables.description:
The ID corresponding to the game to download and run using HLDS.

The HLDS server ID is 90. This should not be changed.

variables.name: Game directory
variables.description: Native HLDS mod depot name. Changing it requires reinstall and a map belonging to that mod. Examples: cstrike, valve, dod, tfc. Custom mods require their native game files.

variables.name: Steam beta branch
variables.description: Empty selects the current public publisher build. steam_legacy selects the publisher legacy branch.

variables.name: Steam service port
variables.description: Zero automatically selects a distinct additional allocation. Explicit values must be allocated.

variables.name: Validate
variables.description: Validate game files on update. Keep it disabled with ReHLDS due to SteamCMD overwriting its changes

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam account used to download files (Defaults to anonymous)

import hashlib
from contextlib import contextmanager
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata

    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',

                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)

    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)

        try:

def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')

    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):

    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')

class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output

    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')

        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)

                path = PurePosixPath(member.name)
                if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.name or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                    raise ValueError('Unsafe SteamCMD bootstrap archive')
                if path.as_posix() == '.':

                    raise ValueError('Duplicate SteamCMD bootstrap path')

                if len(seen) > 10000 or total > 512 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap expansion exceeds its limit')
                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)
                if member.isdir():
                    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            if not (ready / name).is_file():
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap is missing its launcher')

        if target.exists():
            raise ValueError('Incomplete existing SteamCMD folder needs operator review')
        os.replace(ready, target)
        (target.parent / 'steamcmd-bootstrap.json').write_text(json.dumps({'url': BOOTSTRAP, 'sha256': checksum.hexdigest(), 'bytes': count}) + '\n')


def update(root, app_id, env=None, validate=True, required=(), platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):

    if supplied_root != root:
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume must not contain symlinks or traversal')
    _publication_check(root)
    bootstrap(root)
    _publication_check(root)
    child_env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': str(root)}
    for name in ('PYTHONHOME', 'PYTHONPATH', 'LD_PRELOAD'):
        child_env.pop(name, None)
    # The bundled Python dependency directory belongs to the helper only.
    child_env.pop('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', None)
    print('SteamCMD: refresh target metadata, then ' + ('validate/install' if validate else 'update') + ' application ' + str(app_id), flush=True)
    child = subprocess.Popen(['timeout', '--signal=TERM', '--kill-after=30s', '7200s', *args], cwd=root, env=child_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    secrets = [env.get(key, '') for key in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH', 'SRCDS_BETAPASS')]
    redactor = Redactor(secrets)

    except BaseException:

        # contain Steam credentials. Never let that exception reach the console.
        raise RuntimeError('Steam helper interrupted; inspect the redacted output') from None

        raise SteamInstallError(app_id, status, failure_reason(failure_tail, app_id))
    _publication_check(root)
    receipt = manifest(root, app_id)
    for name in required:
        path = root / name
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            raise ValueError('Steam installation lacks a required server file')

        with _publication_parent(root, '.voltra/steamcmd/linux' + bits + '/steamclient.so') as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is None or _publication_leaf(parent, name) is None:
                continue
            descriptor = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as source:
                metadata = os.fstat(source.fileno())
                if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
                    raise ValueError('Steam SDK source must be a regular file')
                _publish(root, '.steam/sdk' + bits + '/steamclient.so',
                         lambda output: shutil.copyfileobj(source, output), metadata.st_mode & 0o777)
    payload = (json.dumps({**receipt, 'branch': env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '') or 'public', 'platform': platform}, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    _publish(root, '.voltra/steam-template-release.json', lambda output: output.write(payload))
    return receipt

        # the previous interpreter for recovery, without touching operator data.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Shared checksum/staging/preservation for native tar-based game releases."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request


def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1048576), b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def preserve_identity(prepared, original):
    identity = original.stat()
    os.chown(prepared, identity.st_uid, identity.st_gid)
    prepared.chmod(stat.S_IMODE(identity.st_mode))


def download(release, target, cache_root=None):
    if not release['url'].startswith('https://'):
        raise ValueError('Native release download requires HTTPS')
    # An installer may receive immutable public blobs copied into its own
    # volume before installation. Never link writable game data to a cache.
    if cache_root is None:
        managed = next((p for p in target.parents if p.name == '.voltra'), None)
        cache_root = managed / 'public-cache' if managed is not None else None
    if cache_root is not None:
        cache_root = Path(cache_root)
        digest = release.get('sha256', '')
        if len(digest) != 64 or any(c not in '0123456789abcdef' for c in digest):
            raise ValueError('Public native cache requires a SHA-256 identity')
        cached = cache_root / digest
        if cache_root.is_symlink() or cached.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('Native public cache must not use symlinks')
        if cached.exists():
            if not cached.is_file() or (release.get('bytes') and cached.stat().st_size != release['bytes']) or sha256(cached) != digest:
                raise ValueError('Native public cache failed integrity validation')
            with cached.open('rb') as source, target.open('xb') as out:
                shutil.copyfileobj(source, out)
            if sha256(target) != digest:
                target.unlink()
                raise ValueError('Native cached copy failed integrity validation')
            print('Verified public native archive reused from cache.', flush=True)
            return
    with urllib.request.urlopen(release['url'], timeout=120) as source, target.open('xb') as out:
        shutil.copyfileobj(source, out)
    if release.get('bytes') and target.stat().st_size != release['bytes']:
        raise ValueError('Native archive size mismatch')
    if sha256(target) != release['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Native archive checksum mismatch')


def extract(archive, target, prefix):
    seen, total = set(), 0
    with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:*') as source:
        for member in source:
            parts = PurePosixPath(member.name).parts
            if member.name.startswith('/') or '..' in parts or '\\' in member.name:
                raise ValueError('Unsafe native archive path')
            if prefix is not None:
                if not parts or parts[0] != prefix:
                    raise ValueError('Unexpected native archive prefix')
                if len(parts) == 1:
                    if not member.isdir():
                        raise ValueError('Native archive root must be a directory')
                    continue
                parts = parts[1:]
            elif not parts:
                if member.isdir() and member.name in ('.', './'):
                    continue

            relative = PurePosixPath(*parts)
            if not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()) or str(relative) in seen:
                raise ValueError('Archive links, special files and duplicate paths are unsupported')
            seen.add(str(relative))
            total += member.size
            if len(seen) > 100000 or total > 4 * 1024**3:
                raise ValueError('Native archive exceeds extraction limits')
            path = target.joinpath(*relative.parts)
            if member.isdir():
                path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            else:
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with source.extractfile(member) as inp, path.open('xb') as out:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(inp, out)
                path.chmod(member.mode & 0o777)

    root = root.resolve()
    state, target = root / '.voltra' / target_name, root / target_name
    if not state.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('Native engine or state directory escapes the server volume')
    receipt = state / 'release.json'
    if receipt.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Native release receipt must not be a symbolic link')
    state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    old = json.loads(receipt.read_text()) if receipt.is_file() else {}
    binary = target / executable
    if old.get('sha256') == release['sha256'] and binary.is_file() and sha256(binary) == old.get('binary_sha256') and all((target / name).is_file() for name in old.get('files', {})):
        print('Native release ' + release['version'] + ' and operator files retained.', flush=True)
        return
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.stage-', dir=state) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        download(release, stage / 'archive')
        ready = stage / 'ready'
        ready.mkdir()
        extract(stage / 'archive', ready, release['prefix'])
        if not (ready / executable).is_file():
            raise ValueError('Native archive is missing the server executable')
        for name, text in (defaults or {}).items():
            if not (target / name).exists():
                (ready / name).write_text(text)
        files = {p.relative_to(ready).as_posix(): sha256(p) for p in ready.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        backup = state / ('previous-' + str(time.time_ns()))
        replacements = []
        try:

                source, destination = ready / name, target / name
                if not destination.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
                    raise ValueError('Native destination escapes the server volume')
                if destination.is_symlink():
                    raise ValueError('Existing native file must not be a symbolic link')
                if destination.exists():

                        raise ValueError('Existing native file must be a regular file')

                    # modified stock assets remain overrides across updates.

                    if preserve:
                        continue
                    saved = backup / name
                    saved.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    shutil.copy2(destination, saved)
                    # Installer processes commonly run as root while Wings owns
                    # existing server files. copy2 retains mode but not owner.
                    # Prepare both rollback and new content before publication.
                    for prepared in (saved, source):
                        preserve_identity(prepared, destination)
                else:
                    saved = None
                destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                os.replace(source, destination)
                replacements.append((destination, saved))
            staged = stage / 'receipt.json'
            staged.write_text(json.dumps({**release, 'binary_sha256': sha256(binary), 'files': files}, indent=2) + '\n')
            if receipt.exists():
                preserve_identity(staged, receipt)
            os.replace(staged, receipt)
        except BaseException:
            for destination, saved in reversed(replacements):
                if saved is None:
                    destination.unlink()
                else:
                    os.replace(saved, destination)
            raise
    print('Native release ' + release['version'] + ' installed; operator files preserved.', flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Shared SteamCMD contract for imported game templates, without shell flags."""
import hashlib
from contextlib import contextmanager
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata


def _publication_check(root):
    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)


def _publish(root, relative, writer, default_mode=0o644):
    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)
        temporary, descriptor, identity = None, None, None
        try:
            for attempt in range(5):
                candidate = '.voltra-publish-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
                try:
                    descriptor = os.open(candidate, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                         0o600, dir_fd=parent)
                    temporary = candidate

                except FileExistsError:
                    continue
            if descriptor is None:
                raise ValueError('Cannot reserve a private Steam publication file')
            identity = os.fstat(descriptor)
            with os.fdopen(os.dup(descriptor), 'wb') as output:
                writer(output)
                output.flush()
            metadata = previous or volume
            if os.geteuid() == 0:
                os.fchown(descriptor, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
            os.fchmod(descriptor, stat.S_IMODE(previous.st_mode) if previous else default_mode)
            os.fsync(descriptor)
            with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (current, leaf, _):
                if current is None or (os.fstat(current).st_dev, os.fstat(current).st_ino) != (os.fstat(parent).st_dev, os.fstat(parent).st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication parent changed')
                latest = _publication_leaf(current, leaf)
                signature = lambda value: None if value is None else (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)
                if signature(latest) != signature(previous):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication destination changed')
                candidate = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                if (candidate.st_dev, candidate.st_ino) != (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication temporary file changed')
                os.replace(temporary, name, src_dir_fd=parent, dst_dir_fd=parent)
                temporary = None
                os.fsync(parent)
            _publication_check(root)
        finally:
            if temporary is not None and identity is not None:
                # Remove only the inode reserved by this invocation. A replaced
                # or unknown name is never deleted as failure cleanup.
                try:
                    current = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                    if (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                        os.unlink(temporary, dir_fd=parent)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
            if descriptor is not None:
                os.close(descriptor)


class SteamInstallError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, app_id, status, reason):
        self.app_id, self.status, self.reason = app_id, status, reason
        super().__init__('SteamCMD failed (' + reason + '); inspect the redacted installation output')


def failure_reason(output, app_id):
    clean = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', output)
    expected = ("ERROR! Failed to install app '" + str(app_id) + "' (Invalid platform)").encode('ascii')
    return 'invalid_platform' if any(line.strip() == expected for line in clean.splitlines()) else 'steamcmd_failed'


def arguments(root, app_id, env, validate=True, platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    # SteamCMD reparses its argv using its own command language. Raw argv is
    # therefore not a faithful credential transport (e.g. a leading + value
    # becomes another command). Keep unverified private paths unavailable.
    if (env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '') or env.get('STEAM_PASS', '') or
            env.get('STEAM_AUTH', '') or env.get('STEAM_USER', '') not in ('', 'anonymous')):
        raise ValueError('Private Steam credentials are not enabled until native command parsing is verified')
    if not isinstance(app_id, int) or isinstance(app_id, bool) or not 1 <= app_id <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError('Choose a numeric Steam application ID')
    branch = env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '')
    if branch and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}', branch):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam branch name')
    credentials = [env.get(name, '') for name in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH')]
    if any(value.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value) for value in credentials):

    if platform not in ('linux', 'windows'):
        raise ValueError('Choose a reviewed Steam target platform')
    if not isinstance(force_platform, bool): raise ValueError('Platform selection must be an explicit boolean')
    if env.get('WINDOWS_INSTALL', '1' if platform == 'windows' else '0') != ('1' if platform == 'windows' else '0'):
        raise ValueError('Steam target platform does not match this reviewed template')
    args = [str(root / '.voltra/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh'), '+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand', '1',
            '+@NoPromptForPassword', '1', '+force_install_dir', str(root)]

            '+app_info_update', '1', '+app_info_print', str(app_id)]

def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'

        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')

        return

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)

            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):

                if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.name or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):

                if path.as_posix() == '.':

                if path.as_posix() in seen:

                seen.add(path.as_posix()); total += member.size

                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)

def update(root, app_id, env=None, validate=True, required=(), platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):

"""MIT. Bundle installed Debian Python for the matching Debian Steam runtime.

Run inside the Debian installer, after apt installed python3. The runtime image

import json

import sysconfig

def bundle(root):
    root = root.resolve()

                'packages_sha256': hashlib.sha256(packages.encode()).hexdigest()}
    if (target / 'runtime.json').is_file() and json.loads((target / 'runtime.json').read_text()) == identity:
        environment = {**os.environ, 'PYTHONHOME': str(target), 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH': str(target / 'lib')}
        probe = subprocess.run([str(target / 'bin/python3'), '-c', 'import ssl,sqlite3,urllib.request,tarfile,ctypes,json'], env=environment, capture_output=True)
        if probe.returncode == 0:

            return
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.python-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary) / 'ready'
        (stage / 'bin').mkdir(parents=True)
        library = stage / 'lib'; library.mkdir()
        shutil.copy2(Path(sys.executable).resolve(), stage / 'bin/python3')
        shutil.copytree(sysconfig.get_path('stdlib'), library / ('python' + sysconfig.get_python_version()),
                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__', 'site-packages', 'dist-packages', 'test', 'tests'))
        binaries = [stage / 'bin/python3', *library.rglob('*.so')]
        dependencies = set()
        for binary in binaries:
            result = subprocess.run(['ldd', str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            if result.returncode:
                raise ValueError('Cannot inspect bundled Python dependencies')
            if 'not found' in result.stdout:
                raise ValueError('Installer is missing a Python shared library')
            dependencies.update(re.findall(r'=>\s+(/[^\s]+)', result.stdout))
        # Keep the runtime image's glibc and ELF loader together.
        glibc = ('libc.so.', 'libm.so.', 'libdl.so.', 'libpthread.so.', 'librt.so.', 'libresolv.so.', 'libutil.so.')
        for name in sorted(dependencies):
            source = Path(name)
            if not source.name.startswith(glibc):
                shutil.copy2(source, library / source.name)
        notices = stage / 'licenses'; notices.mkdir()
        for source in Path('/usr/share/doc').glob('*/copyright'):
            shutil.copy2(source, notices / (source.parent.name.replace(':', '_') + '.copyright'))
        (stage / 'packages.txt').write_text(packages)
        (stage / 'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity) + '\n')
        backup = root / '.voltra' / ('python-previous-' + str(time.time_ns()))
        if target.exists():
            os.replace(target, backup)
        try:
            os.replace(stage, target)
        except BaseException:
            if backup.exists():
                os.replace(backup, target)
            raise
        # Unchanged reinstalls reuse a checked bundle. Changed packages retain
        # the previous interpreter for recovery, without touching operator data.
    print('Debian Python runtime and package notices installed.', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    bundle(Path.cwd())

def private_bytes(path, content, metadata=None):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-',dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as output:
            output.write(content)
            if metadata is not None:
                os.fchown(output.fileno(),metadata.st_uid,metadata.st_gid)
                os.fchmod(output.fileno(),metadata.st_mode&0o777)
        os.replace(temporary,path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def install(root, game, env=None, validate=True):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    if game not in GAMES:raise ValueError('Unknown reviewed survival game')
    app, platform, required, protected = GAMES[game]
    if not (root/'.voltra'/game/'publisher-backups').resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError('Backup directory escapes the server volume')
    previous = {}
    for name in protected:
        target = root/name
        if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError('Native configuration escapes the server volume')
        if target.exists():
            if target.stat().st_size > 8*1024*1024:raise ValueError('Native configuration exceeds 8 MiB')
            previous[name] = (target.read_bytes(),target.stat())
            private_bytes(root/'.voltra'/game/'publisher-backups'/(str(time.time_ns())+'-'+name.replace('/','-')), previous[name][0])
    try:
        release=update(root, app, env=env, platform=platform, validate=validate, required=required)
        if game=='enshrouded':
            from enshrouded_proton import provision
            provision(root)
        return release
    finally:
        for name, (content,metadata) in previous.items():private_bytes(root/name, content,metadata)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    install(Path.cwd(), sys.argv[1], dict(os.environ))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Shared native stdin/output supervision with redaction and ready autosave."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
from steam_template import Redactor


def terminal_queries(data, pending=b'', final=False):
    """Minimal opt-in DSR replies, not a VT screen emulator. Position is 1;1."""
    data=pending+data;output=bytearray();replies=[];index=0
    queries={b'\x1b[6n':b'\x1b[1;1R',b'\x1b[5n':b'\x1b[0n'}
    while index<len(data):
        matched=next((q for q in queries if data.startswith(q,index)),None)
        if matched:
            replies.append(queries[matched]);index+=len(matched);continue
        if not final and any(q.startswith(data[index:]) for q in queries):return bytes(output),data[index:],replies
        output.append(data[index]);index+=1
    return bytes(output),b'',replies

def carriage_return_input(data, previous_cr=False):
    """Normalize command Enter bytes, including CRLF split across reads."""
    output=bytearray()
    for byte in data:
        if byte==10:
            if not previous_cr:output.append(13)
        else:output.append(byte)
        previous_cr=byte==13
    return bytes(output),previous_cr


def validated_stop_sequence(sequence):
    if not isinstance(sequence,tuple)or len(sequence)>8:raise ValueError('Stop sequence must be a bounded tuple')
    for index,step in enumerate(sequence):
        if not isinstance(step,tuple)or len(step)!=2:raise ValueError('Stop steps require command and acknowledgment')
        command,marker=step
        if not isinstance(command,str)or not command or len(command)>2048 or any(c in command for c in '\r\n\0'):raise ValueError('Invalid stop sequence command')
        if marker is None:

            return
        if not stop_sequence:

        if saver:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Shared SteamCMD contract for imported game templates, without shell flags."""
import hashlib
from contextlib import contextmanager
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request

BOOTSTRAP = 'https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz'


@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata


def _publication_check(root):
    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)


def _publish(root, relative, writer, default_mode=0o644):
    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)
        temporary, descriptor, identity = None, None, None
        try:
            for attempt in range(5):
                candidate = '.voltra-publish-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
                try:
                    descriptor = os.open(candidate, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                         0o600, dir_fd=parent)
                    temporary = candidate
                    break
                except FileExistsError:
                    continue
            if descriptor is None:
                raise ValueError('Cannot reserve a private Steam publication file')
            identity = os.fstat(descriptor)
            with os.fdopen(os.dup(descriptor), 'wb') as output:
                writer(output)
                output.flush()
            metadata = previous or volume
            if os.geteuid() == 0:
                os.fchown(descriptor, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
            os.fchmod(descriptor, stat.S_IMODE(previous.st_mode) if previous else default_mode)
            os.fsync(descriptor)
            with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (current, leaf, _):
                if current is None or (os.fstat(current).st_dev, os.fstat(current).st_ino) != (os.fstat(parent).st_dev, os.fstat(parent).st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication parent changed')
                latest = _publication_leaf(current, leaf)
                signature = lambda value: None if value is None else (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)
                if signature(latest) != signature(previous):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication destination changed')
                candidate = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                if (candidate.st_dev, candidate.st_ino) != (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                    raise ValueError('Steam publication temporary file changed')
                os.replace(temporary, name, src_dir_fd=parent, dst_dir_fd=parent)
                temporary = None
                os.fsync(parent)
            _publication_check(root)
        finally:
            if temporary is not None and identity is not None:
                # Remove only the inode reserved by this invocation. A replaced
                # or unknown name is never deleted as failure cleanup.
                try:
                    current = os.stat(temporary, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
                    if (current.st_dev, current.st_ino) == (identity.st_dev, identity.st_ino):
                        os.unlink(temporary, dir_fd=parent)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
            if descriptor is not None:
                os.close(descriptor)


class SteamInstallError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, app_id, status, reason):
        self.app_id, self.status, self.reason = app_id, status, reason
        super().__init__('SteamCMD failed (' + reason + '); inspect the redacted installation output')


def failure_reason(output, app_id):
    clean = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', output)
    expected = ("ERROR! Failed to install app '" + str(app_id) + "' (Invalid platform)").encode('ascii')
    return 'invalid_platform' if any(line.strip() == expected for line in clean.splitlines()) else 'steamcmd_failed'


def arguments(root, app_id, env, validate=True, platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    # SteamCMD reparses its argv using its own command language. Raw argv is
    # therefore not a faithful credential transport (e.g. a leading + value
    # becomes another command). Keep unverified private paths unavailable.
    if (env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '') or env.get('STEAM_PASS', '') or
            env.get('STEAM_AUTH', '') or env.get('STEAM_USER', '') not in ('', 'anonymous')):
        raise ValueError('Private Steam credentials are not enabled until native command parsing is verified')
    if not isinstance(app_id, int) or isinstance(app_id, bool) or not 1 <= app_id <= 2**31 - 1:
        raise ValueError('Choose a numeric Steam application ID')
    branch = env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '')
    if branch and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}', branch):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam branch name')
    credentials = [env.get(name, '') for name in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH')]
    if any(value.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value) for value in credentials):
        raise ValueError('Steam credentials cannot contain controls or begin with command prefixes')
    if credentials[0] and credentials[0] != 'anonymous':
        if not credentials[1]:
            raise ValueError('A Steam account password is required for account login')
        login = credentials[:2] + ([credentials[2]] if credentials[2] else [])
    else:
        login = ['anonymous']
    if platform not in ('linux', 'windows'):
        raise ValueError('Choose a reviewed Steam target platform')
    if not isinstance(force_platform, bool): raise ValueError('Platform selection must be an explicit boolean')
    if env.get('WINDOWS_INSTALL', '1' if platform == 'windows' else '0') != ('1' if platform == 'windows' else '0'):
        raise ValueError('Steam target platform does not match this reviewed template')
    args = [str(root / '.voltra/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh'), '+@ShutdownOnFailedCommand', '1',
            '+@NoPromptForPassword', '1', '+force_install_dir', str(root)]
    if platform == 'windows' or force_platform:
        args += ['+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType', platform]
    args += ['+login', *login,
            # Required for first installs in a cold SteamCMD metadata cache.
            '+app_info_update', '1', '+app_info_print', str(app_id)]
    if app_id == 90:
        game = env.get('HLDS_GAME', 'cstrike')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}', game):
            raise ValueError('Choose a native HLDS mod directory')
        args += ['+app_set_config', '90', 'mod', game]
    args += ['+app_update', str(app_id)]
    if branch and branch != 'public':
        args += ['-beta', branch]
    beta_password = env.get('SRCDS_BETAPASS', '')
    if beta_password:
        if not branch or branch == 'public' or beta_password.startswith(('+', '-')) or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in beta_password):
            raise ValueError('A beta password requires a selected private branch')
        args += ['-betapassword', beta_password]
    if env.get('INSTALL_FLAGS', ''):
        raise ValueError('Use typed Steam options instead of arbitrary INSTALL_FLAGS')
    if validate:
        args += ['validate']
    return args + ['+quit']


def manifest(root, app_id):
    path = root / 'steamapps' / ('appmanifest_' + str(app_id) + '.acf')
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    values = {}
    for key in ('appid', 'StateFlags', 'buildid'):
        matches = re.findall(r'"' + key + r'"\s+"([0-9]+)"', text)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Steam manifest is missing an unambiguous ' + key)
        values[key] = int(matches[0])
    if values['appid'] != app_id or values['StateFlags'] != 4 or values['buildid'] < 1:
        raise ValueError('Steam did not leave a fully installed application manifest')
    return values


class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output


def bootstrap(root):
    target = root / '.voltra/steamcmd'
    if target.is_symlink() or not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError('SteamCMD destination escapes the server volume')
    if (target / 'steamcmd.sh').is_file() and (target / 'linux32/steamcmd').is_file():
        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.steam-bootstrap-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary)
        archive = stage / 'steamcmd.tar.gz'
        checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(BOOTSTRAP, timeout=120) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap redirected outside HTTPS')
            while True:
                block = response.read(1048576)
                if not block:
                    break
                count += len(block)
                if count > 128 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap archive exceeds its size limit')
                checksum.update(block)
                output.write(block)
        ready = stage / 'ready'; ready.mkdir()
        seen, total = set(), 0
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as source:
            for member in source:
                path = PurePosixPath(member.name)
                if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in member.name or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                    raise ValueError('Unsafe SteamCMD bootstrap archive')
                if path.as_posix() == '.':
                    continue
                if path.as_posix() in seen:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate SteamCMD bootstrap path')
                seen.add(path.as_posix()); total += member.size
                if len(seen) > 10000 or total > 512 * 1024**2:
                    raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap expansion exceeds its limit')
                destination = ready.joinpath(*path.parts)
                if member.isdir():
                    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    with source.extractfile(member) as inp, destination.open('xb') as output:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(inp, output)
                    destination.chmod(member.mode & 0o777)
        for name in ('steamcmd.sh', 'linux32/steamcmd'):
            if not (ready / name).is_file():
                raise ValueError('SteamCMD bootstrap is missing its launcher')
            (ready / name).chmod(0o755)
        if target.exists():
            raise ValueError('Incomplete existing SteamCMD folder needs operator review')
        os.replace(ready, target)
        (target.parent / 'steamcmd-bootstrap.json').write_text(json.dumps({'url': BOOTSTRAP, 'sha256': checksum.hexdigest(), 'bytes': count}) + '\n')


def update(root, app_id, env=None, validate=True, required=(), platform='linux', *, force_platform=False):
    supplied_root = root.absolute()
    root = root.resolve()
    env = os.environ if env is None else env
    args = arguments(root, app_id, env, validate, platform=platform, force_platform=force_platform)
    if supplied_root != root:
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume must not contain symlinks or traversal')
    _publication_check(root)
    bootstrap(root)
    _publication_check(root)
    child_env = {**os.environ, 'HOME': str(root)}
    for name in ('PYTHONHOME', 'PYTHONPATH', 'LD_PRELOAD'):
        child_env.pop(name, None)
    # The bundled Python dependency directory belongs to the helper only.
    child_env.pop('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', None)
    print('SteamCMD: refresh target metadata, then ' + ('validate/install' if validate else 'update') + ' application ' + str(app_id), flush=True)
    child = subprocess.Popen(['timeout', '--signal=TERM', '--kill-after=30s', '7200s', *args], cwd=root, env=child_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    secrets = [env.get(key, '') for key in ('STEAM_USER', 'STEAM_PASS', 'STEAM_AUTH', 'SRCDS_BETAPASS')]
    redactor = Redactor(secrets)
    failure_tail = b''
    import sys
    try:
        while True:
            block = child.stdout.read1(16384)
            if not block:
                break
            failure_tail = (failure_tail + block)[-8192:]
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(redactor.feed(block)); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(redactor.feed(b'', final=True)); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        status = child.wait()
    except BaseException:
        child.terminate()
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()
            child.wait()
        # TimeoutExpired includes the original command arguments, which can
        # contain Steam credentials. Never let that exception reach the console.
        raise RuntimeError('Steam helper interrupted; inspect the redacted output') from None
    if status != 0:
        raise SteamInstallError(app_id, status, failure_reason(failure_tail, app_id))
    _publication_check(root)
    receipt = manifest(root, app_id)
    for name in required:
        path = root / name
        if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            raise ValueError('Steam installation lacks a required server file')
    for bits in ('32', '64'):
        with _publication_parent(root, '.voltra/steamcmd/linux' + bits + '/steamclient.so') as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is None or _publication_leaf(parent, name) is None:
                continue
            descriptor = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as source:
                metadata = os.fstat(source.fileno())
                if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
                    raise ValueError('Steam SDK source must be a regular file')
                _publish(root, '.steam/sdk' + bits + '/steamclient.so',
                         lambda output: shutil.copyfileobj(source, output), metadata.st_mode & 0o777)
    payload = (json.dumps({**receipt, 'branch': env.get('SRCDS_BETAID', '') or 'public', 'platform': platform}, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    _publish(root, '.voltra/steam-template-release.json', lambda output: output.write(payload))
    return receipt

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Bundle installed Debian Python for the matching Debian Steam runtime.

Run inside the Debian installer, after apt installed python3. The runtime image
must use the same Debian major release. Keep package notices beside the bundle.
"""
import json
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import sysconfig
import tempfile
import time


def bundle(root):
    root = root.resolve()
    target = root / '.voltra/python'
    if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Python bundle escapes the server volume')
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    packages = subprocess.check_output(['dpkg-query', '-W', '-f=${binary:Package}\t${Version}\n'], text=True)
    identity = {'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'debian_major': Path('/etc/debian_version').read_text().strip().split('.')[0],
                'packages_sha256': hashlib.sha256(packages.encode()).hexdigest()}
    if (target / 'runtime.json').is_file() and json.loads((target / 'runtime.json').read_text()) == identity:
        environment = {**os.environ, 'PYTHONHOME': str(target), 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH': str(target / 'lib')}
        probe = subprocess.run([str(target / 'bin/python3'), '-c', 'import ssl,sqlite3,urllib.request,tarfile,ctypes,json'], env=environment, capture_output=True)
        if probe.returncode == 0:
            print('Debian Python runtime already installed and import checks passed.', flush=True)
            return
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.python-', dir=target.parent) as temporary:
        stage = Path(temporary) / 'ready'
        (stage / 'bin').mkdir(parents=True)
        library = stage / 'lib'; library.mkdir()
        shutil.copy2(Path(sys.executable).resolve(), stage / 'bin/python3')
        shutil.copytree(sysconfig.get_path('stdlib'), library / ('python' + sysconfig.get_python_version()),
                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__', 'site-packages', 'dist-packages', 'test', 'tests'))
        binaries = [stage / 'bin/python3', *library.rglob('*.so')]
        dependencies = set()
        for binary in binaries:
            result = subprocess.run(['ldd', str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            if result.returncode:
                raise ValueError('Cannot inspect bundled Python dependencies')
            if 'not found' in result.stdout:
                raise ValueError('Installer is missing a Python shared library')
            dependencies.update(re.findall(r'=>\s+(/[^\s]+)', result.stdout))
        # Keep the runtime image's glibc and ELF loader together.
        glibc = ('libc.so.', 'libm.so.', 'libdl.so.', 'libpthread.so.', 'librt.so.', 'libresolv.so.', 'libutil.so.')
        for name in sorted(dependencies):
            source = Path(name)
            if not source.name.startswith(glibc):
                shutil.copy2(source, library / source.name)
        notices = stage / 'licenses'; notices.mkdir()
        for source in Path('/usr/share/doc').glob('*/copyright'):
            shutil.copy2(source, notices / (source.parent.name.replace(':', '_') + '.copyright'))
        (stage / 'packages.txt').write_text(packages)
        (stage / 'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity) + '\n')
        backup = root / '.voltra' / ('python-previous-' + str(time.time_ns()))
        if target.exists():
            os.replace(target, backup)
        try:
            os.replace(stage, target)
        except BaseException:
            if backup.exists():
                os.replace(backup, target)
            raise
        # Unchanged reinstalls reuse a checked bundle. Changed packages retain
        # the previous interpreter for recovery, without touching operator data.
    print('Debian Python runtime and package notices installed.', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    bundle(Path.cwd())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import time


def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'
    result, seen_sections, seen_keys = [], set(), set()
    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline
        if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)
            missing(name)
    return ''.join(result)


def private_write(path, content):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):
        raise ValueError('Native configuration leaves the server volume')
    if path.exists():
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as source:previous = source.read()
    else:previous = ''
    updated = patch_ini(previous, sections)
    if updated != previous:
        if path.exists():private_write(backups / (str(time.time_ns()) + '-' + path.parent.name + '-' + path.name), previous)
        private_write(path, updated)
    else:path.chmod(0o600)

"""MIT. Typed Steam and confined, receipted Valheim/V Rising mod overlays."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re

def confined(root,relative):
    path=PurePosixPath(relative)
    if not path.parts or path.is_absolute()or'..'in path.parts or'\\'in relative:raise ValueError('Mod path must stay in this volume')
    target=root.joinpath(*path.parts)
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError('Mod path follows an external link')
    if any(p.is_symlink()for p in [target,*list(target.parents)[:len(path.parts)]]):raise ValueError('Mod destinations must not follow links')

def api(url):
    request=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Voltra-Setup/1','Accept':'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=45)as response:
        data=response.read(8*1024**2+1)
        if len(data)>8*1024**2:raise ValueError('Publisher metadata exceeds limit')
        return json.loads(data)


def acquire(root,release,target):

    if cached.is_file()and not cached.is_symlink():
        if not cached.resolve().is_relative_to(root):raise ValueError('Mod cache leaves volume')
        shutil.copyfile(cached,target)
    else:
        request=urllib.request.Request(release['url'],headers={'User-Agent':'Voltra-Setup/1'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=120)as response,target.open('xb')as output:
            if not response.geturl().startswith('https://'):raise ValueError('Mod redirect requires HTTPS')
            total=0
            while True:

                total+=len(block)
                if total>256*1024**2:raise ValueError('Mod archive exceeds limit')
                output.write(block)
    digest=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if release.get('sha256')and digest!=release['sha256']:raise ValueError('Mod publisher archive checksum mismatch')
    return {**release,'sha256':digest,'bytes':target.stat().st_size}

def package_id(value):
    pieces=value.replace('/','-').split('-')
    if len(pieces)!=3 or not all(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]+',part)for part in pieces[:2])or not re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+',pieces[2]):raise ValueError('Modpack must be namespace-name-version')

    result=[];visiting=set();visited=set()

        if identifier in visiting:raise ValueError('Cyclic Thunderstore dependencies')
        if identifier in visited:return
        if depth>16 or len(visited)+len(visiting)>256:raise ValueError('Modpack dependency limit exceeded')
        owner,name,version=package_id(identifier);visiting.add(identifier)
        metadata=api('https://thunderstore.io/api/experimental/package/'+owner+'/'+name+'/'+version+'/')
        for child in metadata.get('dependencies',[]):visit(child,depth+1)
        visiting.remove(identifier);visited.add(identifier)
        if not(owner=='denikson'and name=='BepInExPack_Valheim'):result.append({'identifier':identifier,'url':'https://thunderstore.io/package/download/'+owner+'/'+name+'/'+version+'/'})
    visit(value);return result

def install(root,kind,env):
    root=Path(root).resolve()
    if kind not in('valheim','vrising'):raise ValueError('Unknown survival game')
    variant=env.get('VOLTRA_'+('VALHEIM'if kind=='valheim'else'VRISING')+'_VARIANT','vanilla')

    previous_path=confined(root,'.voltra/'+kind+'/installation.json')
    previous=json.loads(previous_path.read_text())if previous_path.is_file()else{}
    managed={name:digest for release in previous.get('overlays',[])for name,digest in release.get('files',{}).items()}
    def pinned(release):
        if not release.get('sha256'):

        if pack:

                files=overlay(root,archive,plugin_directory='BepInEx/plugins/'+release['identifier'],managed=managed)
                receipt['overlays'].append({**identity,'files':files})
        current={name for release in receipt['overlays']for name in release.get('files',{})}

        # its prior receipt, never arbitrary operator plugin directories.
        for name,digest in managed.items():

@contextmanager
def _publication_parent(root, relative, create=False):
    """Walk from the volume with anchored directory FDs, never symlinks."""
    parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
    if not parts or PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Steam publication path')
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    if root.resolve() != root or root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Steam publication volume path changed')
    descriptor = os.open(root, flags)
    volume = os.fstat(descriptor)
    try:
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            try:
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not create:
                    yield None, parts[-1], volume
                    return
                os.mkdir(part, 0o755, dir_fd=descriptor)
                next_descriptor = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=descriptor)
                try:
                    if os.geteuid() == 0:
                        os.fchown(next_descriptor, volume.st_uid, volume.st_gid)
                except BaseException:
                    os.close(next_descriptor)
                    raise
            os.close(descriptor)
            descriptor = next_descriptor
        yield descriptor, parts[-1], volume
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _publication_leaf(parent, name):
    try:
        metadata = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Steam publication destination must be a regular file')
    return metadata


def _publication_check(root):
    # Run before bootstrap/SteamCMD and again after the publisher, including
    # missing leaves: existing parent components must still be confined.
    for relative in ('.voltra/steam-template-release.json',
                     '.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so', '.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so',
                     '.voltra/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so'):
        with _publication_parent(root, relative) as (parent, name, _):
            if parent is not None:
                _publication_leaf(parent, name)


def _publish(root, relative, writer, default_mode=0o644):
    """Publish new bytes while retaining existing ownership and permissions."""
    with _publication_parent(root, relative, create=True) as (parent, name, volume):
        previous = _publication_leaf(parent, name)
        temporary, descriptor, identity = None, None, None
        try:
            for attempt in range(5):
                candidate = '.voltra-publish-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
                try:
                    descriptor = os.open(candidate, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                         0o600, dir_fd=parent)

                    continue

                raise ValueError('Cannot reserve a private Steam publication file')
            identity = os.fstat(descriptor)

                writer(output)
                output.flush()

            if os.geteuid() == 0:
                os.fchown(descriptor, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
            os.fchmod(descriptor, stat.S_IMODE(previous.st_mode) if previous else default_mode)

class Redactor:
    """Keep incomplete credential matches across pipe reads out of console output."""
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = sorted({v.encode('utf-8') for v in values if v}, key=len, reverse=True)
        self.keep = max((len(v) for v in self.values), default=1)
        self.pending = b''

    def feed(self, chunk, final=False):
        self.pending += chunk
        cut = len(self.pending) if final else max(0, len(self.pending) - self.keep)
        if not final:
            for secret in self.values:
                position = self.pending.find(secret)
                while position >= 0 and position < cut:
                    if position + len(secret) > cut:
                        cut = position
                        break
                    position = self.pending.find(secret, position + 1)
        output, self.pending = self.pending[:cut], self.pending[cut:]
        for secret in self.values:
            output = output.replace(secret, b'[redacted]')
        return output

"""MIT. Preserve native INI comments and unknown settings during managed updates."""
import os

def patch_ini(content, sections):
    newline = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else '\n'
    result, seen_sections, seen_keys = [], set(), set()
    section = None

    def missing(name):
        for key, value in sections.get(name, {}).items():
            if (name, key) not in seen_keys:
                result.append(key + ' = ' + value + newline)
                seen_keys.add((name, key))

    for line in content.splitlines(keepends=True):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(?:[;#].*)?', line.strip())
        if header:
            missing(section)
            section = header.group(1)
            if section in sections and section in seen_sections:
                raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI section: ' + section)
            seen_sections.add(section)
        elif section in sections and not line.lstrip().startswith((';', '#')) and '=' in line:
            key = line.split('=', 1)[0].strip()
            if key in sections[section]:
                if (section, key) in seen_keys:
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate managed INI key: ' + key)
                seen_keys.add((section, key))
                line = line.split('=', 1)[0] + '= ' + sections[section][key] + newline

            result[-1] += newline
        result.append(line)
    if result and not result[-1].endswith(('\n', '\r')):
        result[-1] += newline
    missing(section)
    for name in sections:
        if name not in seen_sections:
            result.append('[' + name + ']' + newline)

    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.voltra-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as output:
            output.write(content)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):os.unlink(temporary)


def configure_ini(root, path, sections, backups):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path, backups = Path(path), Path(backups)
    if not all(p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for p in (path, backups)):
        raise ValueError('Native configuration leaves the server volume')

            seen.add(str(relative));total+=member.size

            if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(stage.resolve()):raise ValueError('Proton archive leaves staging directory')
            if member.isdir():target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

class RCON:
    def __init__(self,port,password):
        self.connection=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=4);self.connection.settimeout(4)
        self.send(3,password,31)
        for _ in range(4):
            identifier,kind,_=self.receive()
            if identifier==-1:raise ValueError('RCON authentication rejected')
            if kind==2 and identifier==31:return
        raise ValueError('RCON authentication response missing')
    def send(self,kind,body,identifier=32):
        data=struct.pack('<ii',identifier,kind)+body.encode()+b'\0\0'
        self.connection.sendall(struct.pack('<i',len(data))+data)
    def exact(self,count):
        data=b''
        while len(data)<count:
            block=self.connection.recv(count-len(data))
            if not block:raise OSError('RCON closed')
            data+=block
        return data
    def receive(self):
        length=struct.unpack('<i',self.exact(4))[0]
        if not 10<=length<=1024**2:raise ValueError('Invalid RCON frame')
        data=self.exact(length)
        if not data.endswith(b'\0\0'):raise ValueError('Invalid RCON terminator')
        identifier,kind=struct.unpack('<ii',data[:8]);return identifier,kind,data[8:-2].decode('utf-8','replace')
    def command(self,command):
        if any(c in command for c in '\r\n\0') or len(command)>8192:raise ValueError('Invalid console command')
        self.send(2,command)
        for _ in range(16):
            identifier,kind,body=self.receive()
            if identifier==32:return body
        raise ValueError('RCON command response missing')
    def close(self):self.connection.close()
